title: Dev7 enforced adapter dispatch and outbox-bound authority
summary: Adapter dispatch refuses a missing guard and independently revalidates publication approval, exact account/surface capability, policy, full request binding and an already acknowledged outbox dispatching checkpoint. Does not claim production secure storage or live vendor adapters.
invariants: SocialAdapterProvider must be constructed with SocialDispatchGuard; an unguarded provider wrapper cannot be used.
An approvalRef is only lineage. Independent publication authority and exact scoped capability must both approve at time of dispatch.
A low-level call to SocialLibrary~execute with valid approval and capability but no dispatching outbox checkpoint cannot dispatch.
The local requestObject is removed before vendor-adapter dispatch, and the journal does not serialise that object.
Development journal is single writer with checksum only; no production fsync, interprocess lease, tamper-proof signature or exact-once guarantee.
Raw adapter objects must remain inaccessible to untrusted callers; a plain in-process wrapper does not sandbox them.
procedure: Configure one journal, scoped resolver, trusted publication authority and provider policy.
Construct SocialScopedPublicationService with the SAME journal and resolver; set authority.
Submit through scoped facade: journal records prepared then dispatching; guarded provider checks recorded state before real dispatch.
On unknown remote outcome, reconcile using independent remote proof; never blindly retry.

provenance.claim: Lower-layer dispatch guard and required adapter wrapper
Non-recovering journal inspection for active dispatch
